subject: pe
title: VO2 Max in Context
welcome_lead: Cyclists, marathoners and sedentary — what shapes the elite values?
meta_desc: A-Level PE adventure on factors affecting VO₂max and population norms.
final_note: Elite cyclists' VO₂max reflects years of training built on favourable genetics.

walkthroughs.body_html: HERITAGE Family Study (1992–) shows ~50% of VO₂max trainability is heritable.
Untrained: ~10% loss per decade. Trained masters athletes can hold values 50–60% above sedentary peers.
Cross-country skier Bjørn Dæhlie reportedly tested ~96 mL kg⁻¹ min⁻¹ — among highest ever recorded.
